highlights_led_by_exploit_ready_vulns: Estée Lauder discloses data breach via Oracle E-Business flaw and SonicWall SMA1000 flaws exploited as zero-days to push custom malware. Treat newly published PoCs and early exploitation signals as immediate patch/mitigation triggers for internet-facing and fleet-wide infrastructure.
endpoint_posture_under_pressure: HollowGraph malware uses Microsoft 365 calendar for command and control. Tighten EDR coverage, block known IoCs where available, and validate software supply-chain integrity in build and CI/CD.
identity_and_edge_access_risks: JadePuffer agentic attacks now target AI model data with ransomware. Prioritize MFA enforcement, phishing-resistant authentication, and reduce management-plane exposure for edge services and remote access.
